interpretations: Group matched appearance records by `bats`, excluding only the empty string; include `NULL` as its own group in the total and average.
Group matched appearance records by `bats`, excluding both the empty string and `NULL`; calculate the total and average across the remaining groups.
queries:
SELECT p.bats,
       SUM(a.g_all) AS total,
       AVG(a.g_all) AS average
FROM appearances AS a
JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
WHERE p.bats IS NULL OR p.bats <> ''
GROUP BY p.bats

SELECT p.bats,
       SUM(a.g_all) AS total,
       AVG(a.g_all) AS average
FROM appearances AS a
JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats <> ''
GROUP BY p.bats
